entries.text: The TPC-DI data warehouse schema now follows Clause 3.2 of the specification: DimTrade replaces FactTrade, and DImessages, Prospect, Financial, Audit and the FactHoldings trade keys are added, with exact numeric types for money and quantities.
details: Flag columns are BOOLEAN on DuckDB, where true = 1 evaluates to true, and a 0/1 SMALLINT on other platforms.
Staging tables for the ETL load are created with the warehouse tables. TPC-DI stays unavailable while it is reworked.
